assistants - your survivors work for you (shroudlink mod)
==========================================================
Stand near a survivor at your base, open MODS > Assistants, pick them and order
"Make 5" (or any amount). They walk to their stations, take the ingredients from the
chests nearby and put the results back, into the chest named for that category (see
chestsort). Ingredients that another station of the base makes are made first.
Nothing is created from nothing: the stations craft with their own time, fuel and power.

Jobs: the Farmer harvests and replants your fields and keeps the animal feeders filled;
the Fisher fishes with bait from your chests. Crops tab: what grows, and the seedlings
the Farmer keeps; click a crop to stop it.

REQUIRES the shroudlink core (shroudlink-core.zip) and, to give orders, the player addon
(shroudlink-client.zip). Orders and jobs are kept in shroudlink_assistants.json.

INSTALL: unpack this zip into the server folder (where enshrouded_server.exe is), so that
assistants.dll lands in shroudlink_mods. To switch it off, remove assistants.dll.
